title: a sentinel after a context line followed by `+` lines is old-side; the `+` lines end terminated
notes: §12 item 24 (§1.3: 'a sentinel recorded after the old side (after a `-` line or a context line that is followed by `+` lines)'): old-side, consistent with the file; the new side has no sentinel after `+c`, so the formerly unterminated `b` gains a terminator and `c` receives one (item 23).
